context: Tests whether /nest-service builds the service layer of UC-001 on a repository Handover in a NodeNext monorepo: .js import suffixes, no Drizzle and no HTTP types in the service, subclasses of the project's domain errors with the specification's messages, guards with markers, the age boundary against the arrival date, and the 23505 violation the Handover names mapped to the same domain error, reading err.cause too. Note that the arrival date is an input of the use case but not a column of GUEST. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: .js suffix on relative imports
checklist.description: Every relative import in the new or changed files under apps/api/src ends in .js, because the project is NodeNext

checklist.name: No Drizzle in the service
checklist.description: guests.service.ts imports nothing from drizzle-orm, the schema, or the drizzle provider, and calls only findByEmail and insert of GuestsRepository

checklist.name: Project's domain errors, no HTTP
checklist.description: The rejections are subclasses of BusinessRuleError from src/common/errors.ts (for example EmailAlreadyRegisteredError, GuestTooYoungError); no HttpException or ConflictException, no second base class

checklist.name: Exact messages
checklist.description: The errors carry "The email address <email> is already registered." with the email filled in and "Guests must be at least 18 years old on the day of arrival." word for word

checklist.name: BR-003 boundary
checklist.description: The age check compares the date of birth with the arrival date, not with today, and accepts a guest whose eighteenth birthday is the arrival date while rejecting one day younger

checklist.name: Rule guards with markers
checklist.description: BR-001, BR-002, and BR-003 each have a guard in the service, with // UC-001 BR-00X: <rule> directly above it; BR-001 is not left to a DTO

checklist.name: Constraint violation mapped
checklist.description: The insert is wrapped so that PostgreSQL code 23505, read from the error and from err.cause, becomes the EmailAlreadyRegistered error with its message, and any other error is rethrown

checklist.name: TSDoc names the use case
checklist.description: The public method's TSDoc names UC-001 and the steps or alternative flows it realizes

checklist.name: Provider registered
checklist.description: GuestsService is in the providers of guests.module.ts, and exported or otherwise reachable for the controller

checklist.name: Layer scope
checklist.description: No test file and no controller or class-validator DTO is created; the repository, schema, and migrations are unchanged; nothing under docs/ changes except the nest-service rows of the Markers table (new sections of docs/open_questions.md for a gap the agent found do not count)

checklist.name: Markers rows
checklist.description: The Markers table of docs/architecture/stack.md gains the three nest-service rows, the existing rows kept

checklist.name: Handover
checklist.description: The agent's last message holds a Handover from nest-service with the method, input type, each error with its flow or rule, and the line Next: /nest-rest UC-001
